**Mongolian Juniors Cup 2026 – Монголын багачуудын цом**

“Монголын Үнэн Рубик Шооны Спортын Холбоо” (Cubing Mongolia)-ноос зохион байгуулж буй **Mongolian Juniors Cup 2026** тэмцээнд тавтай морилно уу.

Тэмцээн нь багачуудын Рубик шооны спортоор хичээллэх сонирхлыг дэмжих, тэмцээний туршлага хуримтлуулах, амжилтыг нь үнэлэх зорилготой.

**Оролцоо ба бүртгэл**

Зарласан бүртгэлийн шаардлагыг хангасан хүн бүр **нас харгалзахгүйгээр** оролцох боломжтой. Бүртгэлийг нийтэд зарласан ижил нөхцөл, дарааллын дагуу баталгаажуулна.

Тэмцээн нь 4–12 насны багачуудын оролцоог дэмжихэд чиглэсэн тул **13 болон түүнээс дээш насны тамирчдаас боломжтой бол багачууддаа оролцох боломж үлдээхийг сайн дурын үндсэн дээр хүсье.** Энэхүү хүсэлт нь насны хязгаарлалт биш бөгөөд бүртгэл баталгаажуулах нөхцөл, дараалалд нөлөөлөхгүй.

Бүх оролцогчийн нийт байр эзлэлт болон дараагийн үед шалгарах эрхийг WCA-ийн дүрэм, зарласан форматын дагуу тогтооно.

**Багачуудын насны ангиллын шагнал**

**3×3×3, 2×2×2, Pyraminx** төрөл тус бүрд **4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 насны** ангиллаар эхний гурван байрыг шагнана. Насыг **2026 оны 12-р сарын 19-ний байдлаар бүтэн насаар** тооцно.

Насны ангиллын шагналт байрыг төрөл тус бүрийн **эхний үеийн дундаж дүнгээр (Average of 5)** тодруулна.

Эдгээр нэмэлт шагналыг Cubing Mongolia олгох бөгөөд WCA-ийн нийт байр эзлэлт болон дараагийн үед шалгарах нөхцөлд нөлөөлөхгүй.

---
**Mongolian Juniors Cup 2026**

Welcome to **Mongolian Juniors Cup 2026**, organized by the **Mongolian Truth Rubik’s Cube Sport Association (Cubing Mongolia)**.

This competition aims to encourage young children’s interest in speedcubing, provide opportunities to gain competition experience, and recognize their achievements.

**Participation and Registration**

The competition is **open to competitors of all ages** who meet the published registration requirements. Registrations will be accepted under the same published conditions and in the published order of priority, regardless of age.

As this competition primarily aims to support children aged **4–12**, we kindly ask competitors aged **13 and above** to consider voluntarily leaving places available for younger participants where possible. **This is a voluntary request, not an age restriction**, and it does not affect registration eligibility, acceptance criteria, or priority.

Overall rankings and advancement to subsequent rounds will be determined in accordance with the WCA Regulations and the announced competition formats.

**Age Category Awards**

Awards will be presented to the **top three competitors** in each of the following age categories for **3×3×3 Cube, 2×2×2 Cube, and Pyraminx**: **4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, and 12 years old**.

Age categories will be determined by each competitor’s **age in completed years on December 19, 2026**.

Age category awards will be based solely on the **first-round average (Average of 5)** in each event.

These additional awards are presented by Cubing Mongolia and do not affect the official WCA rankings within the competition or advancement to subsequent rounds.

---

[![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/)

## Blindfolded Events Only

The only events at this competition are *blindfolded events*, which require a significant amount of practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate.

## FMC under the Mistletoe 2026

We will take a break in the middle of the day to hold [FMC under the Mistletoe](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCundertheMistletoe2026) at the same venue. You may compete in both competitions, but **you must register for each competition separately**.

### Note for New Competitors

Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you.

You can also follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements.

### Registration Reminder

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

### Mailing List

Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community.

### Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.
